# Roxy

> Roxy is a feedback widget for websites, made for coding agents. A client points at what's wrong on a staging site and writes a sentence; Roxy adds a screenshot, the clicked element (CSS selector, text, HTML), the page, the browser and window size, and the last console errors and failed requests. A coding agent reads the feedback over MCP, fixes the code and marks the feedback as done.

Made by kimiyu (https://kimiyu.ch). Hosted in Switzerland. Early access.

## How it works

- The site owner adds a site in the dashboard (https://roxy.kimiyu.ch/app) with its addresses and its GitHub repository, puts one script tag on it, and invites reviewers by email.
- Reviewers sign in with the link from the email (no password). Visitors who aren't invited see nothing.
- Feedback arrives in the dashboard and over MCP.

## For agents: the MCP server

- Endpoint: `https://roxy.kimiyu.ch/mcp` (streamable HTTP), authenticated with a Bearer token the site owner creates.
- Connect Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http roxy https://roxy.kimiyu.ch/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`
- Tools:
  - `list_sites`: the sites the token can reach, each with its GitHub repository.
  - `list_feedback`: feedback per site and status (open / done), with the page path and the element selector.
  - `get_feedback`: one entry in full: text, page, element, browser, console errors, failed requests, and the screenshots as images.
  - `resolve_feedback`: mark it done (or reopen it), with a short note on what changed.
  - `discard_feedback`: delete an entry that isn't feedback.
- Workflow: list the open feedback, open one entry, find the code from the repository, the URL path and the selector, fix it, then resolve it with a note.

## Install on a site

```html
<script src="https://roxy.kimiyu.ch/widget.js" data-site="SITE_KEY" defer></script>
```
